notes.title: Warp into the Danger Zone
notes.notes:
[img]https://res.cloudinary.com/dgevnr9z2/image/upload/v1755013365/header_library_danger_5db56d0f8f.png[/img]

We have a new update, 1.4.0, and things are about to get dangerous!

Introducing an all-new zone: Danger Zone!

This update brings in a brand new zone to the game for those that have completed the main game and are looking for that little extra challenge. Danger Zone brings together elements across all the other zones to devise some of the toughest challenges yet, and also a new boss battle!

Danger Zone will finally bring you face to face with Orbert, the ominously following floating orb that watches over your progress throughout the different zones (and may or may not have had a tough time in the end).

Can you make it through the Danger Zone? 

On top of that, this update also focuses on quality of life improvements and polishing. There are also some bug fixes included.

- Certain levels got a small adjustment
- Adjustments for unlocking certain achievements
- Save data improvements
- Texture improvements
- Bug fixes

As well as some preparations under the hood for the what's next!

notes.title: Update 1.3.5 - Big Improvements
notes.notes:
This update addressed some major performance issues and several fixes.

- Major performance improvements
- Tons of squashed bugs
- Add secondary button (B) for running using a GamePad
- Minor adjustments with some levels

notes.title: Update 1.3.4 - Small Fixes
notes.notes: This update addresses a couple of issues regarding achievement progression and an issue with the Zone Selection screen crashing.

notes.title: Update 1.3.3 - Achievements!
notes.notes:
This update brings a few bug fixes and finally introduces Steam Achievements.

You can now unlock up to 20 achievements, a couple are going to be part of the next major update which introduces a brand-new zone, so stay tuned for that!

notes.title: Small Patch 1.3.2
notes.notes: This update is a small patch which addresses an issue when saving level goals correctly.
